title: Chapter 73 The Inheritance Of The Human Emperor Palace
content:
Chapter 73 The Inheritance Of The Human Emperor Palace

But now, the Xuanyuan Sword, the treasure of the Human Emperor Palace, appeared in front of him.

Looking at the middle-aged man's unbelievable eyes, Lu Xue said weakly: "This, this is what my father gave me."

Hearing this, the middle-aged man asked in confusion: "Your father? Then where did your father come from?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue stopped talking.

Ouyang Yanqing and An Xing on the side just looked at the middle-aged man.

Seeing this, the middle-aged man also knew that he asked too much, and then he coughed lightly and said: "The inheritance of my Human Emperor Palace cannot be broken like this, and you still have the treasure of my Human Emperor Palace. I think no one is more suitable to inherit the inheritance of my Human Emperor Palace than you."

The next moment, an ancient dragon-shaped ring appeared in the middle-aged man's hand.

"This ring represents the supreme status of my Human Emperor Palace. From now on, you are the master of the Human Emperor Palace."

Looking at the ancient ring, Lu Xue blinked.

I don't think I have agreed yet.

Seeing Lu Xue like this, the middle-aged man was shocked. As expected of a person with great luck, he was not so easy to fool.

Then he continued: "Inside, there are all the resources and treasures of my Human Emperor Palace. As long as you inherit my Human Emperor Palace, these things will be yours."

He believed that no one would refuse such good things.

What's more, these are all the resources of his Human Emperor Palace.

The number is absolutely terrifying.

No one can resist such temptation.

However, Lu Xue's words made him dumbfounded.

"I, can I not?"

Lu Xue said weakly.

Hearing this, the middle-aged man was stunned on the spot.

His Human Emperor Palace has now fallen to this point.

When his Human Emperor Palace was glorious, countless creatures were trying their best to enter the Human Emperor Palace, but now, the entire Human Emperor Palace was rejected for free.

For a while, the middle-aged man looked a little depressed.

Seeing the middle-aged man like this, Lu Xue looked a little hesitant, and then turned to look at Ouyang Yanqing.

Seeing this, Ouyang Yanqing sighed and said softly: "Xiaoxue, just make your own decision."

At this time, the Xuanyuan Sword in Lu Xue's hand trembled again.

Sensing the movement, Lu Xue asked in confusion: "Xiaojian, what's wrong with you?"

Seeing this scene, the middle-aged man's face lit up.

"Girl, Xuanyuan Sword is the treasure of my Human Emperor Palace, and it is also the luck of my Human Emperor Palace. It is not complete now, because its power is sealed in my Human Emperor Palace."

Back then, after the Xuanyuan Sword disappeared, the Human Emperor Palace was only depressed for a while, and then it woke up again. The reason is that although the Xuanyuan Sword disappeared, the power of the Xuanyuan Sword remained.

So the Human Emperor Palace can continue to remain powerful.

And now, the Xuanyuan Sword wants to regain its power.

After hearing what the middle-aged man said, Lu Xue also understood, "Then where is its power?"

Hearing this, the middle-aged man did not speak, but smiled.

If you want to know, that requires conditions.

Looking at the middle-aged man, and then at the Xuanyuan Sword in his hand, Lu Xue sighed, spread her hands, and said: "Well, I can accept this inheritance."

If it weren't for the Xuanyuan Sword, she wouldn't accept any inheritance.

Hearing this, the smile on the middle-aged man's face became brighter.

At this moment, he seemed to have seen the glory of the Human Emperor Palace again.

Buzz——

As the middle-aged man waved his hand, a domineering force rose from the depths of the ground in the depths of the Human Emperor Palace.

Instantly, the entire Wanling Realm trembled.

Countless sleeping old monsters woke up one after another, looking at the golden light in the sky with horror.

The breath of the Human Emperor!

Somewhere in the Wanling Realm.

Ye Qing looked at the gray-haired man in front of him and said in a deep voice: "The Human Emperor Palace was destroyed back then, and now we finally have hope. Don't you want to avenge the Human Emperor Palace?"

Hearing this, the man chuckled and said: "Revenge, huh, forget it, the Human Emperor Palace has long been gone."

Looking at the man's decadent appearance, Ye Qing's expression was slightly gloomy.

A long time ago, this was also his appearance.

But now, he really sees hope.

However, he has not gained nothing over the years. After his persuasion, some of the three major forces who survived that year were persuaded by him and agreed to go to the deserted city to find out.

But the person in front of him is very critical.

Because the person in front of him was one of the right-hand men of the master of the Human Emperor Palace back then.

Even he didn't expect that this person was still alive.

It's a pity that although the person is still alive, his heart is dead.

Ye Qing shook his head and turned away.

And at this moment, a golden light suddenly broke through the sky and illuminated the entire Wanling Realm.

Ye Qing stopped walking, looked back, and was shocked.

He was very familiar with this breath. Wasn't it the breath of the Human Emperor that was unique to the Human Emperor Palace back then?

And a long, long time ago, the Human Emperor Palace, the Heavenly Court, and the Holy Gate were one family.

But later, something happened in the Human Emperor Palace, which led to the Human Emperor Palace being divided into three.

On the side, the man was also staring blankly at the golden light above the sky.

He was even more familiar with that breath.

The Human Emperor, the breath of the Human Emperor!

In an instant, a powerful breath surged out of the man's body, which was the half-step breaking heaven realm (strictly speaking, it was still the heavenly realm, but much stronger than the heavenly realm).

"My Human Emperor Palace has not lost yet, I haven't lost yet!!"

The man yelled and then laughed wildly.

After a long time, the man turned to look at Ye Qing and grinned, "Brother Ye, do you still lack people?"

At this time, his hot heart had been illuminated by this golden light again.

Hearing this, Ye Qing smiled and said, "Of course."

......

Another place is in the Human Emperor Hall.

The golden light passed through layers of restrictions and poured straight into the Xuanyuan Sword.

Suddenly, the golden light of Xuanyuan Sword shone, and a domineering aura continued to surge. After a long time, Xuanyuan Sword returned to peace.

Seeing this scene, the middle-aged man looked relieved. If he had this sword back then, maybe he wouldn't have lost so badly.

It’s a pity that he is already a person from the past.

"From now on, you will be the Lord of the Human Emperor Palace. The important task of restoring the Human Emperor Palace will be given to you."

Then the middle-aged man directly stuffed the ancient ring to Lu Xue without waiting for Lu Xue to say anything.

Looking at the ancient ring in his hand, Lu Xue looked at it and immediately showed a look of disgust.

Seeing this, the middle-aged man's mouth twitched slightly.

Is the inheritance of the Other Emperor Palace so bad?

The middle-aged man shook his head and said, "I'll send you out."

After obtaining the inheritance of the Human Emperor Palace, the remains of this Human Emperor Palace are no longer necessary.

However, after hearing this, Ouyang Yanqing and An Xing looked at the middle-aged man.

Lu Xue has benefited, but they are still empty-handed.

The middle-aged man sighed when he noticed the eyes of the two, and then two rays of light poured into the two.

Suddenly, the two of them hurriedly thanked, "Thank you, senior."

Although it is not as good as the rewards from their city lord, it is better than not. After all, it cannot be in vain.

At this time, Ao Qing also reacted and then spoke, "That, I,"

Before he finished speaking, the middle-aged man hurriedly said, "Okay, it's not advisable to stay here for a long time, for fear of chaos. Everyone, say goodbye!"

Suddenly, a light flashed, and Lu Xue and the others disappeared directly.

Ao Qing: ****
